jobs.title: Part-Time Event Security Guard — Arena Safety & Patrol
jobs.description:
Trail Drive Management Corp TDMC is seeking a part-time Event Security Guard to ensure a safe arena environment. Responsibilities include screening guests with magnetometers, responding to incidents, and aiding post-event operations on-site in Fort Worth, TX.

The role requires 18+, a high school diploma or GED, and valid private security registration with Texas. Prior security experience is preferred and the position demands flexibility for nights, weekends, and holidays.
